NO dogs, NO people, NO animals, NO text, NO UI, NO rugs, NO pet beds, NO loose toys, NO objects on the foreground floor. The live dog will be composited in front. Camera at small dog's eye level, facing the back wall. Wall-floor junction at 47 percent image height, clear open floor fills bottom 53 percent. Keep center 50 percent of the image EMPTY from floor to wall, furniture confined to far left/right edges of the room; gentle low contrast behind the dog.
